question_sentence: How many immigration arrests nationwide is ICE now aiming to make each day?

question_sentence: Which capital city could become the first modern city to run out of water by 2030?

question_sentence: Which famous aviator is the focus of a new expedition launched this week?
evidence: One group of researchers is spending $900,000 to determine if Amelia Earhart crashed — and possibly survived — on an uninhabited island in the Pacific Ocean. They traveled to the remote island this week to begin investigating satellite imagery of an object that could either be Earhart’s plane or simply a sunken tree.
